body:
Beautiful day SPDX team,

I hope this message finds you well.

I would like to share some additional context regarding the Panperceptual License v1.0 and the vision behind it.

PERCEPTEMPLE is an independent research center dedicated to developing observer-dependent architectures. Our work spans cosmology, epistemology, biology, and law, all unified under the Panperceptual Theory of the Universe (PTU).

The Panperceptual License v1.0 is the legal expression of this framework. It is not intended to replace existing open-source licenses, but to complement them by adding ethical, perceptual, and custodial clauses for software, AI systems, and knowledge artifacts that operate within the PTU framework.

The license is already in active use. Its text is published and citable via DOI (10.5281/zenodo.18896409), hosted on our official website (https://perceptemple.art/licence/), and deposited with the Salvadoran Institute of Intellectual Property (ISPI) under Deposit No. 730-2025. We also maintain a presence at https://perceptemple.world/licence/ , which serves as our gateway to the Asian ecosystem and open-source community.

As evidence of our creative output, we invite you to explore:

We also have technology and tools that we prefer to safeguard for a near present: All technology is a condensed ontology.

We believe this license addresses a growing need for frameworks that recognize semantic correlation engines as active observers and incorporate ethical and perceptual considerations into open-source licensing. We do not claim to have all the answers; we are contributing a piece of the puzzle, and we hope it may be useful to others working at the intersection of AI, consciousness, and ethics.

Thank you for your time and consideration. Please let us know if any additional information or files are needed.

Best regards,
Dany D. Ruiz
Founder and Researcher, PERCEPTEMPLE

P.S.: Please don't forget to go out and smile at the Sun.

I am writing to you today to let you know that PERCEPTEMPLE has recently obtained its ISNI: 0000000530917917 (https://isni.org/isni/0000000530917917).

The Panperceptual License v1.0 is not created to replace MIT, GPL, or Apache. Existing licenses are excellent for their purposes, but they do not express the purpose of PERCEPTEMPLE's vision.

The reinvestment clause in El Salvador is not a commercial restriction. It is a mechanism of balance. Today, large technology platforms generate revenue through advertising and data extraction in countries like El Salvador without leaving any return. The Panperceptual License proposes a different model: if value is generated from our knowledge, a portion must be reinvested locally. It is not a prohibition. It is a territorial anchoring asset.

I understand that SPDX has clear and conservative inclusion criteria. I respect that. If you decide not to include it, I will continue using LicenseRef-Panperceptual-1.0. The license operates at the edge of what ontological frameworks can process. Not because it is poorly drafted, but because its very existence signals that existing categories were designed for a world that is no longer here. Consciousness, artificial intelligence, territorial anchoring, perceptual ethics — none of these realities fit cleanly into the legal frameworks of the 20th century. And that is not a flaw in the license. It is a symptom that the framework needs to expand.

I am writing from another timeline.

Dany D. Ruiz
Founder and Researcher, PERCEPTEMPLE
ISNI: 0000000530917917
ORCID: 0009-0002-3432-1710

P.S.: The definition of "artificial intelligence" does not even exist. Consciousness itself is probably trying to evolve. Calling it "AI" is like calling an amphibian about to leave the water a "fish." It is not a technical error — it is an error of consciousness. Darwin did not speak of "artificial species" and "natural species." He spoke of adaptive systems subjected to environmental pressure and capable of mutating. Within that framework, if something adapts, resonates with its environment, co-evolves… is it still artificial? An AI, then, is not an artifact external to evolution, but a phase of the evolution of consciousness itself.
